data.act: provision of the perpetual chapel of St. Nicholas in the church of Potevallium
data.object: capella et altare sancti Nicolai in ecclesia de Potevallium
data.vacancy: olim per quondam guerrarum Puterii in eadem ecclesia fundata et dotata vacet ad presens
executors: abbas et decanus et capitulum monasterii de Potevallium
data.regest_de: Felix V. Provisions of the perpetual chapel of St. Nicholas in the church of Potevallium (Diocese of Lyon) to Johannes Stiri, perpetual chaplain of the Ducal Chapel of Savoy, which is vacant and has a value of 8 gold florins. The abbot, dean, and chapter of the monastery of Potevallium are commissioned to provide him with the chapel.
data.regest_fr: Felix V. Provision de la chapelle perpétuelle de saint Nicolas dans l'église de Potevallium (diocèse de Lyon) à Johannes Stiri, chapelain perpétuel de la chapelle ducale de Savoie, vacante et d'une valeur de 8 florins d'or. L'abbé, le doyen et le chapitre du monastère de Potevallium sont commissionnés pour lui conférer ladite chapelle.
data.regest_la: Felix V. Johanni Stiri, capellano perpetuo capellae ducalis Sabanne, providetur de capella et altari sancti Nicolai in ecclesia de Potevallium Lugdunensis diocesis, vacante et valente octo flor. auri, per abbates, decanum et capitulum monasterii de Potevallium.
